entries.title: Theme preset selection showing SaaS.
entries.notes: Capture with only the core Capell stack, Foundation Theme, Layout Builder, and capell-app/theme-saas installed in the isolated demo harness.
entries.useCase: An administrator confirms the SaaS preset is available through the core Themes resource without installing another theme package.

entries.title: Signed admin preview route.
entries.notes: Capture a signed preview URL generated with CreateThemePreviewUrlAction for the seeded SaaS theme, site, and page.
entries.useCase: An administrator opens a signed preview URL to inspect a page with the SaaS theme applied before publishing the theme choice.

entries.title: Frontend page rendered with SaaS theme.
entries.notes: Capture the seeded Launchdeck page after installing capell-app/theme-saas and building the Foundation Theme/frontend assets.
entries.useCase: A visitor sees a seeded product page rendered through the SaaS navigation, hero, features, proof, content listing, CTA, and footer sections.

entries.title: SaaS homepage.
entries.notes: Capture the seeded SaaS homepage with activation hero, feature proof, dashboard panels, workflow cards, and CTA.
entries.useCase: A SaaS team checks that the theme sells product workflow and activation rather than broad startup marketing.

entries.title: SaaS directory page.
entries.notes: Capture the seeded SaaS directory surface with product pathways and resource cards.
entries.useCase: A product team reviews whether listing pages keep SaaS evaluation paths clear.

entries.title: SaaS detail page.
entries.notes: Capture the seeded SaaS detail surface with article-style product story content.
entries.useCase: A SaaS team can publish product stories or feature narratives inside the theme-owned product layout.

entries.title: SaaS contact page.
entries.notes: Capture the seeded SaaS contact surface with enquiry routing and conversion copy.
entries.useCase: A sales team checks that demo/contact conversion stays tied to product workflow.

entries.title: SaaS empty state page.
entries.notes: Capture the seeded SaaS empty-state surface for no-results and recovery flows.
entries.useCase: A user sees a useful recovery page when a product search or listing has no results.

entries.title: SaaS CTA page.
entries.notes: Capture the seeded SaaS CTA surface for focused conversion moments.
entries.useCase: A product team can direct high-intent visitors toward the next sales or trial action.
